notes: 远端「未提交」现在纳入本机待同步数据：后端 status 的 repo 对象新增 pending 与 uncommitted（dirty+pending），面板两处「远端」Kv 改用 uncommitted 并显示「本机待同步 N」，本机新会话/配置改动立即体现在数字上，不必等退出 DSH capture。摘要行「刷新」按钮改为先 check（触发 git fetch 更新远端引用）再刷新，展开时的 30 秒自动刷新复用同一条链。
notesEn: Remote "uncommitted" now includes local pending changes: the status repo object gains pending and uncommitted (dirty+pending); both "Remote" Kv rows use uncommitted and show "N pending on this machine", so new local session/config changes appear immediately without waiting for DSH exit + capture. The summary-row "Refresh" button now runs check (triggering git fetch to refresh remote refs) before refreshing, and the 30s auto-refresh while expanded shares the same chain.
